title: U-Space: Uncovering When and Why Uncertainty Arises in Language Models
summary: Large language models are informing decisions with ever-higher stakes. As the consequences of their errors grow, a central question becomes harder to ignore: how much can we trust an individual answer? Yet recognizing when to defer remains difficult because language models can present incorrect conclusions with fluent explanations and an authoritative tone. Uncertainty quantification seeks to address this disconnect by estimating the reliability of individual predictions. However, many existing …

As the consequences of their errors grow, a central question becomes harder to ignore: how much can we trust an individual answer? Uncertainty quantification seeks to address this disconnect by estimating the reliability of individual predictions.
